# Bone tower shield

Internal ID: ShieldBoneTower | Type: Shield | Source: Workbench | Usage: Blocking | Wielding: Off-hand | Crafting Materials: Wood x10, Bone fragments x10 | Movement speed: -10%

# Introduction

The Bone tower shield is the second tower shield. It has more block armor and force compared to Wood tower shield, and similarly reduces movement speed by 10% as well as increasing dodge roll cost by 10%.
As a tower shield, it cannot be used to parry enemy attacks.

## Upgrade information

Cost to max is 25 wood, 25 bone fragments and 3 skeleton trophies.
